messages:
auditor_olga: Morning team — auditor request: need end-to-end evidence for an RBAC change that touched serviceAccount `inference-proxy-priv` on 2025-07-15. Deliverables: (1) change PR/commit, (2) deploy timeline, (3) KMS events (Decrypt / GenerateDataKey) for alias `rdw-inference-key` around the deploy window, (4) any key rotation events, and (5) vuln triage / incident notes. Where do we pull these from and can you bundle them?

morgan_oncall: Hi @auditor_olga — PR + CI artifact + CloudTrail + k8s audit + KMS key history should cover it. We have an evidence exporter but we need to include GenerateDataKey events too (we use envelope encryption).

devin_infra: PR is github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5021, merge commit c0ffee7 (merged 2025-07-15T02:05:12Z). CircleCI job 12015 executed `kubectl apply -f rollout-proxy-20250715.yaml` at 2025-07-15T02:05:39Z. CI artifact saved: s3://redwood-audit/ci-artifacts/2025/07/15/deploy-proxy-20250715-0205.json.

arya_sec: For KMS: query CloudTrail for eventName in (Decrypt, GenerateDataKey) and requestParameters.keyId matching the CMK or alias arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:alias/rdw-inference-key between 2025-07-15T02:00:00Z and 2025-07-15T02:10:00Z. Splunk example: 
```
index=cloudtrail (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey) "rdw-inference-key" | table _time, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.encryptionContext, sourceIPAddress
```

auditor_olga: Important: auditors need proof the client-side logic set encryptionContext.service_account so we can bind the KMS calls to `inference-proxy-priv`. Will requestParameters include that?

arya_sec: Yes — our KMS envelope wrapper sets encryptionContext with `service_account` and `deploy_id`. CloudTrail preserves requestParameters.encryptionContext. The principal will show the node role but encryptionContext ties to the service account. We'll include raw CloudTrail JSON and a filtered CSV highlighting encryptionContext.

devin_infra: Also captured a k8s audit log snippet showing the SA token exchange and the created pod referencing `serviceAccount: inference-proxy-priv` at 2025-07-15T02:05:40Z: s3://redwood-audit/k8s-audit/2025/07/15/sa-bind-proxy-0205.json.

morgan_oncall: Note on key rotation: there was an alias cutover earlier that week — alias reassignment from key/oldkey -> key/rdw-newkey happened on 2025-07-14T23:58:00Z. CloudTrail records `UpdateAlias` and `ScheduleKeyDeletion` entries. We should include KMS key history (ListAliases/DescribeKey snapshots) from 2025-07-14..2025-07-15 so auditors can see the alias mapping.

auditor_olga: If the alias changed, will decrypt/GenerateDataKey events still point to the alias or to the underlying keyId? We need deterministic linkage.

arya_sec: CloudTrail requestParameters.keyId may show either alias ARN or key ARN depending on client call. We'll include the alias -> key mapping snapshot and a short note explaining how to interpret events. We also captured `kms-history-20250714-20250715.json` at s3://redwood-audit/kms-history/2025/07/14-15/kms-history.json.

devin_infra: CI export artifact, k8s audit snippet, CloudTrail JSON, KMS history, and the PR link will be added to the bundle. I'll add a `mapping.txt` that maps each artifact to SOC2 CC6.1 and ISO A.9 control statements.

morgan_oncall: I'll run the exporter with timeframe and include keys + aliases: `redwood-audit export --range 2025-07-15T02:00:00Z/2025-07-15T02:10:00Z --keys rdw-inference-key --include-ci --include-cloudtrail --include-k8s --include-kms-history --output s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1807770000-proxy-priv-bundle.tar.gz`

export-bot: Evidence export started by morgan_oncall. Job eexp-f77e queued.

arya_sec: Vulnerability/incident notes: INFSEC-1377 (linked in PR) 94 summary: found a potential privilege escalation vector in auth middleware; mitigation applied in PR (least-priv SA token) + runtime ilogging change; monitored 24h. I'll include `INFSEC-1377-summary.txt`.

auditor_olga: Please include a timeline.csv with 10s or better granularity that ties merge -> CI run -> image pull -> pod start -> GenerateDataKey/Decrypt events (timestamped) so we can show causality. Also list redactions applied.

devin_infra: Exporter will create `timeline.csv` with `_time,artifact,detail`. Redactions: node hostnames and customer IPs redacted; principal ARNs and encryptionContext preserved. Checksums in `checksums.sha256`.

export-bot: Evidence export complete: s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1807770000-proxy-priv-bundle.tar.gz (sha256: 4b8c...)

auditor_olga: Received. I'll ingest and validate. One potential follow-up: auditor may request raw CloudTrail for a 1-hour window if they want to re-run queries. We'll need an access request form.

arya_sec: Noted 94 raw CloudTrail will require additional NDA/justification. For internal traceability we also captured pod env snapshot and container startup logs (internal-only): s3://redwood-audit/forensics/proxy-pod-20250715-0206.json and s3://redwood-audit/forensics/proxy-logs-20250715-0206.tgz.

morgan_oncall: Marking thread resolved for now. Reopen if auditor asks for deeper key-material proofs or raw CloudTrail.

auditor_olga: Acknowledged 94 thanks everyone :thumbsup:
